amended.reason: the sampler criterion needs cell wall-clock windows the harness does not record; the harness is not edited while the reference arm runs because its report binds the harness digest

comparison: A cell key is (workload, actors, issuer_delay_ms, repetition).
A key contaminated in any arm is excluded from the paired throughput comparison for all arms.
Report per arm: cells measured, cells contaminated, and medians over all cells and over clean keys.
If a (workload, actors, delay) group keeps fewer than 3 clean repetitions in any arm, its throughput comparison is null with that reason, never estimated.
No cell is rerun and the frozen cell set is unchanged.
contaminated_if: any recorded fixture_failures entry has load_average[0] > threshold
context: load-<arm>.tsv (30 s samples) is reported beside each arm as context; cells carry no wall-clock window, so it does not classify cells.
frozen_before: any measured Kyoei cell; the qualified reference grid was at cell 23 of 80 when this was written

threshold.basis: load1 above the core count means queued runnable work beyond the host; the measured processes themselves add at most actors+3

why: The host is shared; another session drove load1 to 402 during the reference grid (01:00). The contract requires identical host budgets and recording machine load; it does not allow population inference from one-host timing.
